back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are prophesying, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart: Hear the word of the LORD!
The Lord GOD says this: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing.
O Israel, your prophets are like foxes among the ruins.
You have not gone up to the breaches or repaired the wall for the house of Israel, so that it might stand in battle on the Day of the LORD.
They see false visions and lying divinations; they say, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ though the LORD has not sent them, yet they hope for their word to be fulfilled.
Have you not seen a false vision and spoken a lying divination when you say, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ though I have not spoken?”
Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Because you have spoken vanity and seen falsehood, behold, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.

My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and speak lying divinations; they will not be in the council of My people, nor recorded in the register of the house of Israel, nor enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.
Because they have led My people astray, saying, ‘Peace,’ when there is no peace, and when someone builds a flimsy wall, they whitewash it,
tell those who whitewash the wall that it will fall. There will be torrential rain, hailstones will fall, and a windstorm will tear it down.
Behold, when the wall falls, will you not be asked, ‘Where is the whitewash you coated it with?’
Therefore the Lord GOD says this: In My wrath I will release a windstorm, in My anger there will be torrential rain, and hailstones in fury to destroy.
I will tear down the wall you whitewashed, level it to the ground, so that its foundation is exposed; it will fall, and you will be destroyed within it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
When I have vented My wrath against the wall and against those who whitewashed it, I will say to you, ‘The wall is no more, and those who whitewashed it are no more—’
those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw a vision of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Lord GOD.”
“Now you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own heart, and prophesy against them,

and say, the Lord GOD says this: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on every wrist and make veils for the heads of people of every height, to ensnare lives. Will you ensnare the lives of My people but keep your own lives alive?
You have profaned Me among My people for handfuls of barley and scraps of bread, killing those who should not die and sparing those who should not live, by your lies to My people who listen to lies.
Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I am against your magic charms with which you ensnare lives like birds; I will tear them from your arms and set free the lives you ensnare like birds.
I will tear off your veils and deliver My people from your hands, so that they will no longer be prey in your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

Because you have disheartened the heart of the righteous with lies, though I caused him no grief, and have strengthened the hands of the wicked so that he does not turn from his evil way to save his life,
therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will deliver My people from your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
